Jack wrote about the day in the diary. They took many photos at the ticket office. Last Wednesday, Jack and Grace went to the hotel. In fact, laptops out for the security check.
Jack bought a dress at the shop yesterday. Jack hopes to visit Rome one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the hotel by bike. The admission fee includes the tower.
Jack and Grace had great fun there. Both of them like fish and juice. Jack plays football with Grace every Wednesday. The return fare is nine pounds.
Jack thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Grace is interested in dancing. Jack wants to be a teacher in the future.
